verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sill is built for interactive control: touch, keyboard, trackpad and Apple Pencil input, plus adaptive quality and frame-backlog warnings. Nothing documents hardware (e.g. VideoToolbox/HEVC) encoding, and nothing measures or claims latency. Interactive input and adaptive quality are related features, not evidence that the stream itself is hardware-encoded or low-latency.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing
